Coin Headdress & Silver Drops

Source: 24533.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman wears a silver headdress with
coin-like plaques and heart-shaped pendants that fall at
her temples. Red coral beads and silver drop earrings
add color. Her hair is pulled back, and her expression is
calm, with a slight smile. A close-up portrait against a
warm neutral backdrop, with soft directional light.
Palette of silver, coral red, and warm beige. Ornate and
graceful, in the style of a traditional-inspired jewelry
editorial.
Ornate, graceful, intimate
